asset.title: Video
asset.purpose: Live Playwright browser benchmark proof clip. Judge only visible product behavior: fresh-room flow, uploads, public NodeAgent invocation, streaming/tool traces, focus/attention UI, artifact creation/download, and production honesty. Clip duration, silence, or README pacing is not a product defect.

judge.summary: Excellent end-to-end benchmark run showing room creation, file uploads, agent execution, and artifact generation with high fidelity.

featureClarity.evidence: Clear progression from empty room to file uploads, agent execution, and final artifact generation.

workflowCompleteness.evidence: Complete end-to-end flow from room creation to final PDF export preview.

visualDesign.evidence: Clean dark-themed grid layout with clear sidebar navigation and active state indicators.

consistency.evidence: Sidebar shows sheets, documents, and agent traces matching the product's core design.

evidenceQuality.evidence: Real-time execution with visible loading states, streaming text, and interactive document previews.

legibility.evidence: Text in the spreadsheet cells and document viewer is small but legible when zoomed.

professionalRelevance.evidence: Demonstrates automated financial analysis and valuation model generation relevant to investment banking.

productionHonesty.evidence: Displays raw agent logs, execution steps, and token costs in the UI.

judge.suggestedReadmeCaption: Watch NodeAgent automatically ingest financial data and generate a complete valuation model, presentation deck, and PDF report.
